# Appeal of Denial — Request for Reconsideration

**Morgan Foster**
[My street address]
[City, State ZIP]
[My phone number]

**Date:** [Date I am sending this letter]

**To:** Oklahoma Complete Health (Ambetter) — Appeals and Grievances
[Appeal address printed on my denial letter]

**RE: Appeal of adverse benefit determination dated August 10, 2026**
- Member: Morgan Foster
- Member ID: W899181963
- Reference number: POC-4825AA1F8B-42990
- Requested service: Lower back disc surgery / decompression, CPT 63030
- Plan: Oklahoma Complete Health (Ambetter), Commercial/ACA, State of Oklahoma
- Governing policy: **Clinical Policy: Disc Decompression Procedures (CP.MP.114)**, https://www.ambetterhealth.com/content/dam/centene/ambetteril/clinical-policies/CP.MP.114.pdf (Date of Last Revision: 04/25)

---

## What I am asking for

I am appealing the denial of prior authorization for the lower back disc surgery (decompression, CPT 63030) that my surgeon, Dr. Okafor, MD, orthopedic surgery, has documented that I need. The notice I received on August 10, 2026 states that the documentation submitted was incomplete and did not allow a determination of medical necessity. I am asking the plan to reconsider that decision and to approve the procedure.

I believe the records already in my file line up with the plan's own published criteria. Below, I quote the criteria from the plan's policy and point to exactly where each one appears in my records. Where I believe a document may be missing from the plan's file, I say so plainly and am asking that it be requested rather than that my request be closed as incomplete.

This appeal is being submitted within the time allowed. My denial notice states that my appeal must be received within 180 days of the date of the notice, by **February 6, 2027**. I am sending it to the appeal address printed on my denial letter. I am also aware that appeal forms are posted at ambetterhealth.com under my state, and that I can call the number on my member ID card with questions; I am relying on my denial letter for the address and the deadline.

---

## The plan's criteria, and what my records show

**1. Age and diagnosis.** The policy states:

> "A. Age ≥ 18 years; B. Dia gnosis of herniated lumbar disc;"

My date of birth is [my date of birth], and I am over 18. My MRI of the lumbar spine dated July 5, 2026 shows an L4-L5 disc extrusion.

**2. Nerve root compression confirmed by imaging.** The policy states:

> "C. Ne rve root compression confirmed by imaging and one of the following:"

My MRI of July 5, 2026 reports L4-L5 disc extrusion with severe right lateral recess stenosis and compression of the traversing L5 nerve root. That is nerve root compression confirmed by imaging, and it is documented in the imaging report that was part of the prior authorization packet. If that report is not in the plan's file, I ask that it be requested from my surgeon's office before any further determination is made.

**3. The clinical findings that go with the imaging.** The policy allows more than one route here. One route is:

> "2. Radiculopathy with sensory deficit as evidenced by pain, parasthesias or numbness in a nerve root distribution, and member/enrollee has failed to respond to conservative ther apy including all the following:"

My records document radicular pain into my right calf, and an examination showing positive provocative testing on the affected side with a neurologic deficit corresponding to the imaged level. My symptoms have lasted nine months and are progressive, and the pain is not relieved by rest. I cannot stand for more than ten minutes.

The policy also contains a motor-deficit route, which reads:

> "1. R adiculopathy with motor deficit and one of the following: a. Severe weakness in a nerve root distribution, as evidenced by: a score of ≤ 3 on the Me dical Research Council 0 to 5 muscle strength scale, or the inability to ambulate;"

and

> "b. Mild to moderate weakness in a nerve root distribution, as evidenced by a score of 4 on the Medical Research Council 0 to 5 muscle strength scale and one of the following:"

> "i. Worsening weakness or motor deficit; ii. Member/enrollee has failed to respond to conservative therapy, within the last year, including all of the following:"

My records state a neurologic deficit corresponding to the imaged level. They do not assign a Medical Research Council muscle strength score. If the plan's review turned on a muscle strength grade, I ask that my surgeon be asked to supply that specific measurement rather than that the request be denied for incompleteness. My understanding is that the sensory-deficit route above does not require a strength score.

**4. Conservative therapy.** The policy requires all of the following under the sensory-deficit route:

> "a. ≥ four weeks physical therapy or prescribed home exercise program, or doc umentation of member/enrollee’s inability to tolerate;"

I completed supervised physical therapy including core stabilization and lumbar flexibility for 14 weeks, from April 13, 2026 to July 20, 2026, with 20 visits completed. This is documented in my physical therapy discharge note. That is well beyond the four weeks the policy asks for.

> "b. ≥ four weeks activity modification; c. One of the following:"

On activity modification, I am not certain the plan received a document that records this separately. I am asking that [documentation of activity modification and the dates it covers — to be supplied by Dr. Okafor's office] be requested and reviewed before this criterion is treated as unmet.

For the "one of the following" item, the policy lists:

> "i. NSAID or acetaminophen ≥ three weeks unless contraindicated or not tolerated;"

and

> "ii. Epidural steroid injection."

I meet this in two ways. I took NSAIDs for six months with inadequate relief, which is far longer than three weeks. I also received a corticosteroid injection on May 18, 2026, which gave me only about two weeks of partial relief.

The parallel conservative-therapy list under the motor-deficit route reads the same way:

> "a) ≥ four wee ks physical therapy or prescribed home exercise program, or documentation of member/enrollee’s inability to tolerate;"

> "b) ≥ four weeks activity modification; c) One of the following:"

> "1) Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) or acetaminophen ≥ thre e weeks unless contraindicated or not tolerated; 2) Epidural steroid inj ection;"

The same records answer these items.

**5. Other factors in my record.** My file also documents no active infection, no untreated substance use, a BMI of 29, and that I am a non-smoker.

---

## A note about the criteria I was given

Several of the passages I have quoted above end in a colon, which means the policy goes on to list further conditions that I have not been able to obtain. I am not going to guess at what those say, and I have not stated any threshold that I could not find in the plan's own words. Where the policy has not stated a number or a requirement in the text available to me, I have not supplied one.

Because my denial says only that the documentation was incomplete, I am asking the plan to do two specific things:

1. **Identify, in writing, the exact criterion or criteria from Clinical Policy: Disc Decompression Procedures (CP.MP.114) that the reviewer found unmet**, and the specific document or finding that was missing; and
2. **Request that document from Dr. Okafor's office** rather than closing the review as incomplete, if it is something my surgeon can readily supply.

I have not been told which item was missing, and without that information I cannot know what else to send. My surgeon has documented that this procedure is needed, and I would like the plan's decision to rest on the full record.

---

## What I am requesting

I respectfully ask that Oklahoma Complete Health (Ambetter) overturn the denial dated August 10, 2026 (reference POC-4825AA1F8B-42990) and authorize CPT 63030 as requested by Dr. Okafor. If the plan maintains the denial, I ask for a written explanation that identifies the specific criterion from CP.MP.114 that was not met and the specific evidence the reviewer found lacking, along with information about my rights to further review, including external review.

I am happy to provide any additional records the plan needs. Please contact me at [my phone number] or [my email address].

Thank you for taking another look at this.

Sincerely,

**Morgan Foster**
Member ID: W899181963
Date of birth: [my date of birth]
[My signature]
[Date]

**Enclosures:**
- Copy of denial notice dated August 10, 2026 (reference POC-4825AA1F8B-42990)
- MRI lumbar spine report dated July 5, 2026
- Physical therapy discharge note (April 13, 2026 – July 20, 2026, 20 visits)
- Records of NSAID use and corticosteroid injection dated May 18, 2026
- Office notes from Dr. Okafor, MD
- [Any additional documentation my surgeon's office provides]

---

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
